input.quote: Commerce One warrants that the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation, and the media on which the Software is distributed will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period").
input.rationale: Commerce One's product warranty runs only sixty (60) days from the Effective Date and is hard-capped at December 31, 1999, so it can expire before or shortly after acceptance testing (which itself may run to December 31, 1999 under Section 3.1) - well short of our 12-month software position and even the 90-day fallback. There is also no warranty that the installation, implementation, support, training or professional services under Section 5 will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. The remedy in Section 7.3 (correction, replacement, and refund of prepaid fees on termination) is acceptable, and the malicious-code warranty exists but is tied to the same short Warranty Period. We therefore extend the Warranty Period to twelve (12) months from acceptance and add a services warranty with a re-performance/repair/refund remedy.

proposal.summary: Extend software warranty to 12 months from acceptance (removing the Dec 31, 1999 sunset) and add a services warranty with a re-performance/refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the product warranty to twelve (12) months running from acceptance rather than sixty (60) days from the Effective Date with a December 31, 1999 sunset, and added a professional and workmanlike warranty with a re-performance or refund remedy for the installation, implementation, support and professional services, since the agreement currently warrants only the Software. Our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for services with repair, replace or refund; we can fall back to 90 days for the Software warranty if needed.

ops.text: 7.5 Services Warranty. Commerce One warrants that all installation, implementation, support, training and other professional services provided under this Agreement will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and that each deliverable will conform in all material respects to its documentation for ninety (90) days following delivery. Corio's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Commerce One's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services or deliverable.
